description:
Radiance Technologies is an employee-owned company with benefits that are unmatched by most companies in the Dayton OH area. Employee ownership, generous 401K, full health/dental/life/vision insurance benefits, paid time off, educational reimbursement, competitive salaries, interesting assignments and a pleasant work environment combine to make Radiance Technologies a great place to work and succeed.
 
 The Full Stack Software Engineer will support the National Air and Space Intelligence Center (NASIC) by performing software activities focused on assisting the Air Force move forward with digital transformation. Successful candidates will have strong problem solving and critical thinking skills.
 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Design and implement new capabilities

 Resolve issues found in existing code

 Integrate capabilities with external services and tools

 Participate in code reviews and mentor team members 

 Communicate status and technical details with customer

 
 Required Qualifications: 
 3+ years experience

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant STEM field

 U.S Citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance

 Ability to communicate technical details of work

 Ability to work in a dynamic environment and take ownership for segments of a project

 Strong oral and written communication and organizational skills 

 Experience with RESTful web services

 Experience with server-side languages, preference toward Golang, NodeJS, and/or Python 

 Experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks, preference toward Angular, React, and/or Vue

 Experience with version control software (ex Git)

 Experience with bug/issue tracking software such as JIRA

 
 Desired Experience 
 Experience with Kubernetes / HELM

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines utilizing Gitlab CI or Jenkins

 Experience with Docker (containerized deployment)

 Experience utilizing NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB

 Secret Security Clearance or higher

 
 
 Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
